scope: offline re-analysis of one 8-GPU calibration per model (single prompt, seed 101, one request per form, median of 49 steady steps); held-out forms only, not held-out prompts, placements, nodes or workloads

baseline_grid.description: fit_native_profile replica: 3-param saturation model, fixed grid

baseline_cont.description: same formula, continuous bounded fit (latency up to 20 ms)

amdahl_sp.description: baseline comm + replicated compute fraction inside SP group

amdahl_all.description: baseline comm + Amdahl over all cfg*sp ranks

bus.description: shared PHB host-bridge contention: v/B_link + cfg*sp*v/B_bus

bus_amdahl.description: bus contention + replicated compute fraction inside SP group

placement_identifiability.reason: every form measured on exactly one consecutive placement starting at rank 0; per-placement bandwidth is confounded with the form itself
